title: Stabilize and publish benchmark pack for new embedding + reranker variants with version locks
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: finish onboarding of the new embedding model family (embed-x-v2) and the paired reranker (rr-x-small-v1), lock stable model revisions for customer consumption, and publish comprehensive performance profiles into the model catalog. This ticket covers: updating the onboarding manifest schema to include explicit version_lock and quantization tags; running the extended benchmark harness for both single-vector and batch-embedding workloads; reranker pairwise and batch scoring latency/NDCG sweeps; generating canonical profile artifacts (JSON + CSV + flamegraphs) and uploading to the catalog; and adding a canary rollout plan for pinned versions. Outcomes should allow product to pin customers to model_version fields and for Console to surface per-version SLOs.
acceptance_criteria: Manifest schema extended: model_version (semver-ish string) and version_lock: true/false are supported and validated by onboarding CI
End-to-end benchmark runs uploaded: embedding throughput (tokens/s), median/p95 latency, memory footprint, and quantized variant deltas for embed-x-v2 published to model catalog
Reranker evaluation: pairwise latency p50/p95, batch scoring throughput, and NDCG@10/20 across three eval sets published
Performance profile artifact links present in model-catalog entry and referenced in onboarding PR
Console shows per-version latency/cost estimates for embed-x-v2 and rr-x-small-v1 and version pin option is exposed in API (model_version param)
Canary rollout playbook documented with rollback triggers (error rate >2% or p95 latency > baseline+40%) and automated metric checks in CI
